annotations.text: Changed after review: the turn now opens on the Recall step (a real choice, even when the answer is nobody), then a Draw button for turn-start Intel. Nothing resolves on its own. Drawn cards fly in from the deck instead of fading in.

Added after review: the eight primitives as a component sheet, drawn in this draft's own vocabulary. Every game board is composed from these and nothing else. The field lists are the exact data the engine hands each part today. Implementation builds these eight first; the Sweetlands table above is a composition of them (see the last section of the sheet).

Added: the faction portraits and treat icons from the last five rulebook pages, cropped from the source. These replace the colored initials on avatars and the kingdom picker, and the text labels on treat tiles and treat cards.
